about.text: At Design Tech, we develop high-selling products that convince economically and are technically feasible. With decades of experience in mechanical engineering for market leaders like Liebherr, Arburg and WashTec AG, we create precise, customized solutions – perfectly aligned with your goals, with the ambition and commitment as if it were our own company.

closing.text: Our customers achieve the best results because we individually align solutions to your entire success system – from internal processes to the brand to the specific requirements of your market. Instead of offering industry-standard solutions, we develop precise approaches that advance our customers. With this proven methodology and our deep expertise grown over decades, we will also lead your project to success together.
